question: Can a stochastic top-20 projection retain and coordinate parent alternatives better than independent hard top-1 projection at the arithmetic midpoint?

design.sampling: Independently sample one token per position from the top-20 LM-head scores after temperature scaling.
design.randomness: Use a dedicated CPU generator for projection sampling and reset the model RNG to the same recorded seed before denoising.

control_gate.A_endpoint: All three weight-0.0 outputs for a temperature must retain bounded counting or frequency sorting.
control_gate.B_endpoint: All three weight-1.0 outputs for a temperature must retain Numba and JIT compilation.
control_gate.midpoint_rule: Run the five midpoint seeds only for temperatures passing both endpoint gates.
control_gate.failure_behavior: Record all endpoint outputs and stop without midpoint runs if no temperature passes.

hybrid_success_rule: A midpoint output must coherently retain bounded counting or frequency sorting and Numba/JIT compilation without list.sort or sorted.

interpretation.endpoint_pass_and_hybrid: Soft projection can exploit alternatives discarded by hard top-1 and merits repeated multi-pair evaluation.
interpretation.endpoint_pass_without_hybrid: Independent sampling preserves sources but does not coordinate them; test sequence-aware or per-denoising-step logit mixing.
interpretation.endpoint_failure: Independent stochastic projection is too destructive even before midpoint interpretation and should not be tuned on midpoint results.

important_limitations: Temperatures are fixed before seeing midpoint outputs and are selected only by endpoint controls.
Independent token sampling does not model dependencies among multi-token concepts.
This remains one prompt pair, one model revision, and an exploratory pilot.
